articleTitle: Comparison of Object Detection on Drone Using Tensorflow with Several Architectures
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Industrial revolution 4.0 made the world of technology develop more rapidly. Many things that were previously done by humans now become autonomous, one of which is by using drones in various sectors such as agriculture, military, health, and traffic monitoring. Drones that are integrated with cameras make their implementation more extensive. drones that have cameras can be used to detect various kinds of objects. In this research, drones will detect objects in the form of people using the Tensorflow algorithm. Tensorflow has many types of architectures, but this research uses 4 types of architectures namely SSD MobileNet V2 320×320, SSD MobileNet V2 FPNLite 640×640, CenterNet Resnet50 V1 FPN 512×512, and CenterNet Resnet101 V1 FPN 512×512. The architecture that has the best results is CenterNet Resnet50 V1 FPN 512×512 with an accuracy of 94% and an FPS value of 24.39.

articleTitle: Identification and Classification of Arrhythmias on Portable ECG Using ANN Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Heart disease, especially Arrhythmia cannot be seen directly because there are no symptoms, and can only be known by carrying out an examination by a medical expert or using an electrocardiograph (ECG). Most current ECG devices cannot perform classification directly. For this purpose, a classification system that has high accuracy is needed so that the results of the analysis can be credible. The Artificial Neural Network (ANN) method is one of the methods offered because it is suitable for dealing with complex classification problems. In this study, a classification model will be created based on heart wave parameters for Arrhythmia detection. The results of the classification model made have an accuracy of 94.12%. It is hoped that this model can help the process of classifying heart disease which is difficult to diagnose.

articleTitle: Estimated Service Duration in Information Technology Unit Using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: During the current COVID-19 pandemic, the government must change the conventional learning system to online. That way, the use of LMS and Igracias will greatly support this distance learning system or can be called online learning. Of course, with the implementation of the media as a medium of information for students and lecturers, problems will occur on the website. For this reason, Telkom University has created an IT Unit where students can ticket to PUTI for problems experienced by LMS or Igracias. Therefore, in this research, a test will be carried out to find out how the quality of service from the IT Unit in providing maximum service to Telkom University students using the SVM method will be carried out.

articleTitle: Control System Prototype of Feeding And Water Draining in Bucket Catfish Cultivation Based on Arduino Uno
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Catfish is one of the most popular fish in Indonesia. Fish Cultivation in Bucket (Budikdamber) is a potential solution that is encouraged by the community to increase production in the fishery sector. This study aims to build a prototype of an automatic feeding system and control of water turbidity in catfish farming. This research uses ultrasonic input sensor HC-SR04, RTC DS3231, and turbidity sensor SEN0189 as inputs processed in the Arduino UNO microcontroller which produces output on the servo motor, buzzer, and solenoid valve. The level of routine feeding, the status of the void of feed, the level of turbidity (NTU), and the level of the water level in the bucket became the measuring parameters in this study. The results of this experiment showed automatic feeding 3 times a day, namely at 07.30 WIB, 11.30 WIB, and 18.30 WIB. The buzzer will sound when the feed container is empty. Draining the water is carried out when the turbidity of the water reaches 718.84 NTU and is filled again when the turbidity of the water reaches 544.76 NTU. The maximum water level limit is 21.36 cm and the minimum is 33.67 cm as seen from the sensor distance.

articleTitle: Attack Prediction on Internet of Things Using BAT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has limited resources. Even though this device has flexibility in its connection, it leaves a security hole that must be followed up. Nowadays, cyber-attacks have started targeting IoT devices. Therefore, an attack prediction system is needed to keep this IoT device safe. The security system in IoT cannot be turned on continuously due to the limitations of a small memory resource. There needs to be a trigger system from the results of dataset processing to predict attacks. This trigger system will activate security in IoT, such as the blocking method. This feature is very memory friendly so it can be used on all IoT devices with low resources. The prediction scheme is carried out using the BAT algorithm. This algorithm will be compared with the PSO algorithm that first appeared. From the test results, it was found that the accuracy of the BAT algorithm was 9.16% better than the PSO algorithm. This accuracy is widely open to be increased in the future using other algorithms. It is important to get a high accuracy value in predicting attacks on IoT.

articleTitle: Application of D8 Algorithm and Bernoulli Equation for Modeling Surface Water Flow Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Modeling the distribution of water flow is a field of computer graphics science that examines the pattern of water movement from high places to low places. The benefit of this modeling is to find out the pattern of water movement, which can result in the accumulation of water if there is continuous rain resulting in an overflow of water, known as flooding. This paper aims to produce an overview of the movement of surface water flow by applying the multiple flow direction (MFD) method to predict the spread of water flow. Bernoulli's law determines the speed of water flow moving from the origin pixel to other neighboring pixels. The concept of cellular automata is used to regulate cell movement in a consistent, systematic, and structured manner. The test in this study is a digital elevation model (DEM) map dataset, which represents the surface elevation of the area. This study produces an output in the form of a system that can provide an overview of the distribution of surface water flow by applying Bernoulli's law which is used to determine the velocity of water flow, and the MFD method aims to provide certainty of the direction of flow when flowing from one pixel to another.

articleTitle: Design of a Lightweight Obstacle Detection System for Mobile Robot Platforms with a LiDAR Camera
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The treatment of patients in isolation is one of many new challenges that doctors and medical staff have to deal with daily. Thus, recent developments in robotics for the healthcare industry have led to many researchers building autonomous robots to assist in performing menial and labor-intensive tasks, such as delivering items to and from hospital rooms. To develop an indoor navigation system, these robots need a robust obstacle-detection method to guide the robot safely. In this paper, we present a novel and lightweight method to detect obstacles with a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) depth camera for any mobile robot platform that uses the Robot Operating System (ROS) framework. The camera generates a depth image projection of the closest objects in the form of point cloud data. This data is converted into planar data to reduce the computation demand and simplify the incoming depth image data for collision avoidance in a navigation system. The results proved to be highly accurate with the LiDAR camera scanning in three different scenarios.

articleTitle: Finding the Best Techniques for Predicting Term Deposit Subscriptions (Case Study UCI Machine Learning Dataset)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Knowing a lot about attributes, such as bank client data, marketing campaigns, social and economic context, and so on, is necessary to predict which bank customers are likely to sign up for time deposits. The direct marketing campaigns dataset for the bank institution was made available by the UCI machine learning repository. This dataset had previously been used in studies to forecast customers who would sign up for time deposits, but the outcomes of the two studies were different. The purpose of this study is to determine which machine learning methods are most effective for predicting customers who will sign up for time deposits. In this study, researchers used machine learning methods like random forests, K-nearest neighbors, decision trees, naive bayes, logistic regression, SVM, and XGBoost to uncover the truth. Results showed that XGBoost had the highest accuracy (91.73%), followed by the DT classifier (88.79%), LR classifier (91.2%), NB classifier (84.78%), KNN classifier (90.6%), SVM (89.6%), and XGBoost (91.44%).

articleTitle: Face Liveness Detection Using CNN for Face Verification on Medical Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The development of science in the field of technology has accelerated due to the global need for society 5.0 which emphasizes creativity, critical thinking, communication, and collaboration to solve existing problems. One of its applications is to collaborate to create a smart robot using computer vision that can recognize a person's face and verify its authenticity. face recognition uses the identification and classification of faces by comparing matrix values between models and new inputs. Face liveness detection on the robot uses the mediapipe and the CNN algorithm. Facial recognition results get an accuracy value of 92% with an optimal distance of 100 cm.

articleTitle: Analysis of FCL Activation Scenarios in AC/DC Hybrid Electrical Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The use of DC power systems has been abandoned in the past because it is more profitable to use an AC power system. Currently, DC power systems have begun to be used again in the field of renewable energy. The majority of renewable energies such as photovoltaic and wind power plants provide DC output. When the AC power system lacks power to supply the load needs, manufacturers prefer renewable energy. Renewable energy can supply additional power to the AC power system to form a hybrid AC/DC power system. The addition of renewable energy in the hybrid AC/DC power system has an impact on increasing the contribution of short-circuit fault currents. Very high short-circuit fault currents can make the CB unable to work normally and can damage the equipment in the hybrid AC/DC power system. Therefore, this study aims to reduce the contribution of the fault current using FCL. In the method section, several scenarios are created for different FCL placements. Different placement of the FCL affects the decrease in the value of the fault current. Each different FCL placement scenario gives different fault current reduction results as well.

articleTitle: Vision Based Pad Detection for Autonomous Landing Quadcopter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Robust developments in the world of robotics with the presence of commonly called Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), the use of these UAVs can be categorized quite broadly such as for military, security, and other purposes, one of the efforts to improve the performance of UAVs is to add a feature to be able to land autonomously on the landing pad. This research focuses on designing the quadcopter so that it can land precisely on the landing pad using image processing algorithms. First the captured image will be converted to grayscale, then the thresholding method is carried out and followed by a morphological process to eliminate noise and produce a clear image, then the detected image will be displayed in a frame that will calculate the distance to the middle point, then it will be used as Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) input to adjust the direction of motion of the UAV so that it can land autonomously, Testing is carried out to test the accuracy and precision of the designed algorithm. The results of the experiment show an accuracy rate of 94.76% and a precision level of 96.59% with an average landing time of 19 seconds and an average detection time is 8.55 milliseconds.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Wind Power Penetration Effect on Reduction the Harmonics Spread in Steady State Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: In the development of Renewable Energy Source, there are very crucial challenges that must be faced. One of the challenges and characteristics of renewable energy sources is its intermittent nature, especially in Wind Power Plants. The intermittent nature can affect the power quality and frequency stability generated by wind power. The penetration wind power will certainly have an effect of the power flow electrical system. One of the problems that can occur in an electrical system is the spread of harmonics due to the use of non-linear loads on the system. This research consists of two scenarios, the first is simulation with injection of harmonic sources on buses serving industrial load without integrated with wind power and the second scenario is simulation of harmonic spread after penetration of wind power. Both scenarios are carried out with the assumption of steady state system conditions. This simulation is programmed using MATLAB R2017b. This research shows that the inclusion of wind power in the system causes a decrease in the value of THD v on some buses, but the total active power losses increase if the load value on the system remains constant.

articleTitle: Rule-Based Control Strategy for Tempe Fermentation Incubator with Internet of Things Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The problem with traditional tempe production is the length of time the Tempe fermentation process takes. This happens because they still rely on the temperature and humidity of the environment, which is less than ideal. Efforts to overcome these problems with the development of electronic incubators. However, the incubator still uses a lamp that is not ideal for heating and pays less attention to the switching intensity of the actuators. This study aims to develop an incubator with temperature and humidity with a rule base control strategy. In addition, the temperature and humidity of the incubator can be monitored based on the Internet of Things (IoT). The control system design uses Arduino with temperature and humidity sensors (DHT22), while the actuators use fans, heaters, and humidifiers. The wifi connection utilizes the ESP8266 module, and the monitoring application uses the Blynk platform. A rule base is made for decision-making by simultaneously considering temperature and humidity conditions, and hysteresis techniques are accommodated to adjust the switching. The test results show that temperature control is able to reach the range of 31–35 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{oC}$</tex> while humidity control is in the range of 60-70%. The test results show that the Tempe maturity time in the incubator only takes 19 hours for the Tempe to be processed into chips. This will benefit the craftsmen because of the faster time they have the opportunity to increase production capacity.

articleTitle: Development of Text to Speech Technology for Medical Robot Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Health sector is getting better and improving is one of the contributions that can help national development. This is supported by the number of hospitals that have developed and provide medical devices to detect disease. During the Covid-19 pandemic, this disease spread quickly through air and saliva, so social distancing was necessary. Thus, many medical devices, such as measuring body temperature in public places, use sensors that can measure within 5–10 centimeters. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a robot that can detect body temperature and PPG in real-time. The data obtained will be read by text to speech using the GTTS and python text to speech library then the robot will sound in Indonesian. The results obtained show that the data has been successfully read with percentage success rate is 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and data reading speed of 2–6 seconds until the robot speaks.

articleTitle: Programmable AD5933 Chipset-Based Complex Impedance Analyzer System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: A complex impedance analyzer is a programmable measuring device with frequency sweep from 10 to 100 kHz and 10 number of frequency increment. It allows an impedance measurement of an unknown physical system, the so-called Device Under Test (DUT), by exciting it with a sinusoidal at a certain frequency. The response signal from the DUT is sampled by the on-chip ADC, and an on-chip DFT algorithm returns the real (Re) and imaginary (1m) values word at each excitation frequency. A first-order serial RC circuit is used as a testing DUT with values <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10 \mathrm{k}\Omega$</tex> and 470 pF, respectively. The test results report produce the characteristics of actual magnitude <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \boldsymbol{Z}\vert$</tex> in the first order circuit is at high frequency, the capacitor behaves as a short circuit so that the actual magnitude <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \boldsymbol{Z}\vert$</tex> value approaches the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R$</tex> value. The situation is found at the cut-off frequency point of the frequency response obtained. This has implications for the value of the actual phase <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Z$</tex> which is getting closer to 0°.

articleTitle: Identify Impulsivity Levels in the Selection of Leadership Candidates Based on the SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: When selecting a leader, it is necessary to consider their traits based on existing criteria. The criteria for a good leader are excellent decision-making skills, disciplined emotions, and accepts criticism. A leader must not have a high level of impulsivity because they will act according to their whims and desire a high position of power over others. That kind of behavior illustrates that the leader might take action without prior planning or considering any consequences. Experiments for this research are done by recording the condition open eye relaxation. This research uses alpha, beta 1, and beta 2 wave activities using the Support Vector Machine (SVM) method. Signal Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded using Mitsar EEG-202. Then, the signal is filtered using a Band Pass Filter (BPF) with a cut-off of 0.5 Hz - 50 Hz. The resulting tabulation data for each subject were classified using SVM, which showed an accuracy rate of 94.40% with 60% training result data and 40% validation. The results of this study concluded that the level of impulsivity can be observed based on the classification results from the SVM method

articleTitle: IoT-Based on Smart Stick Using Ultrasonic Sensors to Help the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Blindness is a condition in which a person's vision is impaired; this can affect people to the extent that they still have some vision (referred to as low vision) or those who are no longer able to see at all (total blind). Due to the reduced function of the sense of sight, blind people have to rely more on other sensory functions, such as touch, smell, and hearing, to carry out daily activities. An automatic wand designed for visually impaired people to identify obstacles, stones, and obstructions on the right and left sides has been developed and implemented for the purpose of this study. In the process of building the system with the NodeMCU ESP32 acting as the controller, three ultrasonic proximity sensors were used to measure the user's distance and position in relation to obstructions, rocks and other obstructions. In addition, the speaker functions as a sound marker in the form of sound when detecting an object, and the vibrator motor as a marker for the LM35 sensor if it detects the temperature scale. These two markers are activated when the sensor detects an object. According to the findings of comprehensive tool testing, this blind stick has the potential to perform well; specifically, it has the ability to automatically identify obstacles. IoT - Based on Smart Sticks Using Ultrasonic Sensors to Help the Blind which can detect obstacles equipped with Gps which makes it easier for blind families to find out the location or whereabouts of the blind when doing daily activities is one way to help and reduce the worries of families who have visual impairments.

articleTitle: Review of Insulator Coatings to Improve Outdoor Insulator Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Insulator is one of the equipment that is very important in the distribution of electric power systems. Insulation is needed to separate two or more live electric conductors so that between these conductors there is no electric jump or spark. Because of the importance of the insulator in the electric power system, it must be maintained its fairness. Disturbance to the insulator is caused by several factors and is generally caused by external factors, namely environmental factors. The outdoor insulator is affected by these environmental factors and the effects of pollution from the environment. These environmental factors greatly affect the performance of the insulator. To improve the performance of insulators, several attempts have been made, such as the use of new materials, surface coatings to designs to increase dielectric strength. Systematic efforts to improve insulator performance require an understanding of insulator behavior. Insulator characteristics are divided into two, namely mechanical characteristics and electrical characteristics.

articleTitle: Evaluation Usability of Mobile Banking Applications Using Usability Testing (UT) Method and System Usability Scale (SUS)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: BSI Mobile Banking is a Mobile Banking facility provided by Bank Syariah Indonesia for its customers to have access to savings accounts and perform online transactions. In the implementation of BSI Mobile Banking, Usability evaluation still needs to be done to measure the level of usability of the BSI Mobile Banking application and to measure the usability of the BSI Mobile Banking application the level of user satisfaction with the BSI Mobile Banking application based on the results of the research conducted. This research uses the usability method testing with a matrix of learnability, efficiency and error. The distribution of the System Usability Scale questionnaire was used to obtain the satisfaction aspect. Usability testing was carried out by 5 respondents who were new users of the BSI Mobile Banking application. SUS respondents were 100 active users of the BSI Mobile Banking application. Based on the test results, the learnability matrix is 94%, the efficiency aspect is 0.001 goals/sec, and the error aspect is 0.11. Satisfaction matrix using the System. Method usability Scale filled in by 100 respondents with a result of 70,075 from these results it is known that the matrix satisfaction of the BSI Mobile Banking application is included in the acceptable category and gets a C (good) rating.

articleTitle: Analysis of SAMBARA Application Users Based on the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The SAMBARA application is an innovation from the West Java Bapenda for motor vehicle tax services which is expected to provide efficiency, effectiveness, and service improvements to the people of West Java, especially for making tax payments for two-wheeled vehicles. The success of this application can be known by carrying out Usability Testing, namely software testing carried out by developers by involving users using the application. The paper aims to find problems, uses, collect data, and user satisfaction with the product. As well as the TAM method which is the reference for the success of the SAMBARA application, because it is considered a good concept to describe user behavior or customer satisfaction. TAM aims to find out customer response regarding the application, then in the application there are various features that implement TAM namely live chat, comments column. Attitude Toward Using (ATU) in TAM is conceptualized as an attitude towards the use of a system in the form of acceptance or rejection as an impact when someone uses a technology in their work. Behavioral Intention to Use (ITU), namely behavioral tendencies to continue to use a technology. The level of use of a computer technology in a person can be predicted from the attitude of attention towards technology. Actual System Usage (ASU), namely the real condition of system usage. Someone is satisfied using the system if they believe that the system is easy to use and will increase their productivity which is reflected in the real conditions of the user.
